_meta.registers: THEY SPEAK SPANGLISH (Paolo 8/25, LOCKED). A bucket keyed <bucket>@spanglish or <bucket>@es is the same bucket in that register; engine/bohemia_people.js asks for the register first and falls back to plain English, so a missing register is never silence. Every Spanish word ships with an English meaning in ES_LEX, and gates/language_gate.js sweeps the objectives, the resolution buttons and the job offers to prove none of them contains one.
